final_wiki.answer-Q-1222-A10:
Q-1222: What is the largest prime number less than 679?

Answer: 677

Reasoning: 679 = 7 × 97, so 679 is not prime. Checking 678 (even, not prime), then 677. Testing divisibility by all primes up to √677 ≈ 26 (i.e., 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23) — none divide 677. Therefore 677 is prime and is the largest prime less than 679.
